metadata.name: Lava Lamp Vibes
metadata.description: Full-screen WebGL lava lamp interior with very smooth motion: blobs reaching the top or bottom melt fully into the wax there, flattening out, rest while they cool or heat, then gather back up and leave; occasional short-lived trails, slow splits and merges, and a hot glow near the bulb. Bottom bar picks wax/liquid colors; settings panel controls blob size, count, speed, and finish.
